## Nuitsuke

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/nuitsuke.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Throws a needle and thread at an enemy and sews it to the ground where it stands. It can't move but takes no damage. An enemy at least twice as big as the user is sewn all over for 10 seconds instead, and its melee hits don't land.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| --- | --- |
| Cooldown | 10 s (200 ticks) |
| Pack multiplier when dealing damage | 1.35× |

</div>

## Nuiawase

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/nuiawase.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Throws a needle and thread at an enemy and sews it to the closest other enemy, so they can't get away from each other. With no other enemy close by, it is sewn to the ground instead.

## Haute Couture: Patchwork

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/haute_couture_patchwork.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Sews all the enemies and items around the target to it, then pulls the thread so they all crash into the target. The more things hit it, the more damage it takes.
